fact: This is the text of the Freedom of Information Act, 2020 (Chapter 10:33), which gives a right to ask public entities for information; it was published and commenced on 1 July 2020 and repeals the Access to Information and Protection of Privacy Act.

The joint UPR submission says the Freedom of Information Act was operationalised through implementing regulations, citing the Freedom of Information (General) Regulations 2021, SI 229 of 2021; the document is dated July 2026 and the regulations' year is 2021.
The submission treats the Freedom of Information Act 2020 as law in operation, with regulations made under it, and recommends fully implementing it; the Act is dated 2020 by its citation.
